about: Which note rewrites loosen protection, as ONE rule both sides implement: src-tauri/src/note_protection.rs `loosened` and src/lib/protectionRule.ts `loosened` (review 2026-11-20: writers replaced a note's text and dropped `locked`, `secure` or `secureContext`). A rewrite may not turn off locked, secure or secureContext, gain local_ai_allowed, or newly allow an AI body edit. `notePaths` is the file-save lane's refusal (`is_note_path` / `isNotePath`). Both sides' tests run every case. AI body edits rank revoked < person-written < allowed, read without the `locked` line (locked is its own flag). Rust and JavaScript trim different characters (Rust U+0085, JavaScript U+FEFF), so `secure` is named when either trim names it and off only for a value that reads `false` under both.
